questions.question: What does a steady amber traffic light mean?
options: Stop unless too close to stop safely
Speed up to clear the junction
Turn left if the road is clear
questions.explanation: You must stop on amber unless stopping safely is no longer possible.

questions.question: Can you turn left on a red traffic light in the UK?
options: No, you must wait for green
Yes, if no pedestrians are waiting
questions.explanation: There is no turning on red in the UK.
